
## Devcontainer rules (for every AI model and tool)

<!-- Generated by devcontainer-kit. Edit freely; these are the rules the kit relies on. -->

- **Dependencies belong to the devcontainer, not the workspace.** Tools, compilers,
  runtimes, and system packages go in `.devcontainer/` (the Dockerfile, a
  Feature in `devcontainer.json`, or `postCreateCommand`). Do not install them by
  hand in a running container, and do not commit installed tools into the repo.
  Project libraries (Gemfile, package.json, go.mod) are the project's own.
- **After you change `.devcontainer/`, stop.** Say what changed and why, ask the
  user to run "Dev Containers: Rebuild Container", and wait. After the rebuild,
  run `.devcontainer/check-dependencies.sh` and report the result. Do not carry on
  as if the new dependency were installed.
- **Use the latest release** of each language and dependency when adding one,
  looked up now (`.devcontainer/check-versions.sh`, endoflife.date, the package
  registry), not remembered. Ruby comes from the official `ruby` image on Debian slim.
- **Claude sign-in and history live on the host**, in
  `~/.claude-devcontainers/<project>/`, outside the repository. Never commit it.
- **Scheduled checks:** `.github/workflows/scheduled-checks.yml` and Dependabot
  report out-of-date versions and vulnerabilities. Read their results when asked;
  do not re-run them on every change.
